title: Red-first sandbox can run Go toolchain observers
body:
Outcome: red-first and review can prove an infra/ci Go change. The red-first sandbox had no Go, and the runner preload comes from the PR base blob (src/flow/repository.ts readRunnerConfig), so an observer cannot use a capability its own PR adds. Add an optional isolation capability 'go' (missing: approved SKIP(isolation) in and outside CI), resolve the caller's toolchain on the host (go env GOROOT, realpath, regular bin/go), mount GOROOT read-only in the check sandbox with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, and report it in reviewSandboxCapabilities.
Proof: test/isolation-gate.test.ts (go is optional with a label; resolution rejects malformed roots and inactive shims). End-to-end proof is t-xqp3agn's observer once this is on main.
